description: This file defines functions and types for generating available time slots based on date ranges, user availability, and various scheduling parameters. It includes logic for adjusting slot start times, handling out-of-office data, and respecting timezone and interval constraints.

methods.name: minimumOfOne
methods.description: Ensures the input number is at least 1.

methods.name: getCorrectedSlotStartTime
methods.description: Adjusts the slot start time to align with scheduling intervals, respecting 'showOptimizedSlots' option.

methods.name: buildSlotsWithDateRanges
methods.description: Generates available slots within given date ranges, considering out-of-office data, timezone, and interval constraints.

methods.name: getSlots
methods.description: Main exported function that returns available slots based on input parameters, utilizing 'buildSlotsWithDateRanges'.
